title.narrative: Ganzheitliche Grundbildung für Kinder, Jugendliche und Erwachsene in migrantischen und ländlichen Gemeinschaften in Indien
Holistic basic education for children, young people and adults in migrant and rural communities in India

description.narrative: In India, many families live in precarious conditions, especially those who have migrated from rural areas to urban areas due to economic hardship.
